positions.name: OnboardingGovernance
positions.frame: how is the onboarding process established and maintained as a governance artifact?
positions.why: Both expressions read in the direction of onboarding as a governed, mandatory process: src-1 states the universal rule (the Pallasine checklist's required components in the first week), while src-2 reports the supersession that made it current (replacing the old wiki page). The set holds a tension between operational mandate (present habitual, decision conviction) and historical report (past event, claim conviction), but both cohere under the question of how onboarding governance is constituted and kept current.
